label: VSP 7254XSQ
description: Extreme VSP 7254XSQ - 1RU 10/40G Fabric Connect top-of-rack switch (VOSS, VSP 7200 series): 48x 1G/10G SFP/SFP+ in slot 1 (1:1-1:48) and 6x 40G QSFP+ in slot 2 (2:1-2:6). The 48 fibre ports are SFP+ cages, not copper: the 7254XTQ is the 10GBASE-T twin.
notes: Vendor wording (VOSS 8.9 User Guide, "VSP 7200 Series"): "The VSP 7254XSQ has 48 SFP/SFP+ fiber ports. The VSP 7254XTQ has 48 RJ-45 copper ports"; "Slot 1 is the grouping of the 48 10 Gbps ports on the left. Slot 2 is the grouping of the 6 40 Gbps ports on the right." The spec declared no connector, so all 48 slot-1 ports were modelled as RJ45 sockets (audit-port-types, the #60 shape). Contrast case: 1000BASE-T SFP AA1419043-E6 runs at 1 Gbps only in this switch (PHYless design), which is why 1G stays in speedCaps.
